mapper.sql: ID, SESSION_ID, DOCUMENT_KIND, SLOT_KEY, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SHA256, STORAGE_KEY, STATUS, REPLACES_DOCUMENT_ID, REQUESTED_SESSION_VERSION, RESERVED_SESSION_VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, STORED_AT, FAILED_AT, VERSION_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTRACT_REVIEW_DOCUMENT ( ID, SESSION_ID, DOCUMENT_KIND, SLOT_KEY, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SHA256, STORAGE_KEY, STATUS, REPLACES_DOCUMENT_ID, REQUESTED_SESSION_VERSION, RESERVED_SESSION_VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, STORED_AT, FAILED_AT, VERSION_NO ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{sessionId}, #{documentKind}, #{slotKey}, #{originalFileName}, #{fileExtension}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{storageKey}, #{status}, #{replacesDocumentId}, #{requestedSessionVersion}, #{reservedSessionVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{storedAt}, #{failedAt}, #{versionNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_DOCUMENT WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND ID = #{id}
SELECT FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_DOCUMENT WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID
SELECT FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_DOCUMENT WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND STATUS = 'UPLOAD_PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTRACT_REVIEW_DOCUMENT SET STATUS = 'AVAILABLE', STORED_AT = #{storedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{storedAt}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'UPLOAD_PENDING' AND VERSION_NO = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE CONTRACT_REVIEW_DOCUMENT SET STATUS = 'UPLOAD_FAILED', FAILED_AT = #{failedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{failedAt}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'UPLOAD_PENDING' AND VERSION_NO = #{expectedVersion}
